row.reason_if_0: Different business model: HealthEquity is a regulated financial custodian of member HSA balances with interchange and interest income. CorVel is a fee-for-service claims and managed care provider. The offerings do not overlap.
row.reason: CorVel sells workers' comp, auto and liability claims management, bill review, case management and pharmacy services to employers, insurers and TPAs. HealthEquity is an HSA custodian and consumer-directed benefits administrator (HSA, FSA, HRA, COBRA, commuter). It serves employers, health plans and individual account holders. The two share only the generic employer buyer, and they buy for different purposes (risk management vs. HR benefits). Their products do not overlap. HealthEquity also earns custodial, interchange and investment income, which CorVel does not.
